name: P34 candidate markets — the waiting list
description: Markets screened as candidates for the computable-markets catalogue. Proposed blueprints, not catalogue entries: none of these carries a catalogue state and none is in markets.json.

scoring.gate_multiplier: product over the four HyperC criteria: Y=1.0, P=0.9, N=0.6

markets.name: Government & municipal surplus auctions (GovDeals, GSA Auctions, GovPlanet/DLA)
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Heavy equipment auctions; Dealer used-car auctions; 'Surplus laptops' — as a unified supply source it is new
markets.scale: GovDeals 15,000–25,000 active lots/day, 900+ categories, 4.5M+ auctions completed; GovPlanet ~3.5k gov items + 7.4k trucks/trailers.
markets.data: GovDeals/GSA closed results; BidProwl aggregates sold prices across 27 sources (GSA vehicle median $4,314, IQR $1,050–8,565, n=188).
markets.menu: Lot (category × item × condition photos × location × removal deadline) × bid
markets.risk: As-is, photo-only; hard removal deadlines and pickup logistics decide margin; titling.
markets.experiment: Use BidProwl-class archives + a reseller's bid log (won/lost) with pickup cost; score lots within 300 miles; measure abstention on title-issue lots.
markets.sales_tape: Win → pay → pickup (deadline) → title/transport → resale over weeks → storage/abandonment fees

markets.name: Cut-flower & plant clock auctions (Royal FloraHolland, Plantion)
markets.overlap: New — no floral entry in the 135
markets.scale: 2025 product turnover €5.4B; clock >€2B on ~5bn stems; 18,930 distinct products auctioned; >100,000 transactions/day; 35 clocks; ~6,000 growers; 4 hubs.
markets.data: Floriday platform + API; RFH weekly price stats (members); public annual report; clock shows every lot incl. the ones you passed.
markets.menu: Lot (product × grade × grower × day) × trolleys × clock price / pre-sale offer
markets.risk: Turnover minimum + Dutch entity for a new operator; unsold/'doorgedraaid' rates not published; vase-life and downstream sell-through hidden at purchase.
markets.experiment: Log 4 weeks of clock lots for 200 products incl. passes; shadow-score against a wholesaler's realised sales; measure predicted vs realised margin by product/grade.
markets.sales_tape: Clock purchase → cold-chain dispatch → customer sale (florist/exporter) → returns/credit → destruction of unsold stems

markets.name: Independent-retail wholesale buying on Faire / Ankorstore
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Amazon wholesale; E1 'Overlooked supplier catalogue' — the small-retailer, marketplace-supply version
markets.scale: Faire: 100,000+ brands; Ankorstore FY2025: 30,000+ brands, 300,000+ retailers, €1.2B GMV, €160 AOV, ~45% repeat.
markets.data: No retailer-side API; own order history + store POS; platform 'bestseller' badges only.
markets.menu: Catalogue line (brand × SKU × case size × wholesale price × terms) × order qty — the whole catalogue you did not order is the reject set
markets.risk: Sell-through only visible in own POS; taste-driven demand; catalogue snapshots needed for declined set; net-60 hides cash cost.
markets.experiment: Independent retailer: 18 months of Faire orders + weekly catalogue snapshots + POS sell-through; shadow-score reorders and first-time brands; measure abstention on slow categories.
markets.sales_tape: Order → receipt → store sell-through over weeks–months → markdown/return (first order only)

markets.name: Restaurant & commercial-kitchen equipment liquidations
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Office clearance lots; Industrial surplus equipment — distinct vertical
markets.scale: BidSpotter snapshot Sep 2026: 1,853 restaurant/bar lots live; US restaurant closures 886–1,650/month (2025); 2026 chain closures ~1,000 locations.
markets.data: Auctioneer archives (prices realised for registered users); BidSpotter/Proxibid past results; eBay sold; WebstaurantStore new-price comps.
markets.menu: Lot (item × make/model × condition note × location × pickup window) × bid
markets.risk: 'Working when removed'; refrigerant/gas faults; removal deadlines; geographic clustering (WA/GA/FL/CA).
markets.experiment: Used-equipment dealer's 12 months of bids (won/lost) + removal cost + resale; score lots; measure abstention on far-away/heavy lots.
markets.sales_tape: Win → removal (disconnect, rigging) → test/clean → resale (eBay/local) over 2–8 weeks → scrap

markets.name: Cross-border marketplace arbitrage (MercadoLibre Global Selling, Allegro, noon)
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Amazon wholesale / online arbitrage; Walmart and marketplace wholesale (domestic) — cross-border is new
markets.scale: Whole catalogues per country; ML Full storage $0.0005–$0.024/unit/day; category counts unpublished.
markets.data: Marketplace price/BSR history; Nubimetrics / Real Trends for ML (unverified); Keepa-class tools for source side.
markets.menu: SKU (source listing × destination country × marketplace × qty) × landed cost × fees × duties
markets.risk: Duties/VAT and returns are the hidden costs; FX; marketplace rule volatility; Russian platforms off-limits for a US entity.
markets.experiment: Reuse the Amazon OA pipeline: snapshot ML/Allegro catalogues weekly for 3 months, ship 200 SKUs, replay landed margin; measure abstention vs duty surprises.
markets.sales_tape: Source purchase → inbound to ML Full / cross-border parcel → sale → returns/customs delays → biweekly payout

markets.name: Used-smartphone wholesale lots (B-Stock carrier/insurer storefronts, Back Market supply)
markets.overlap: Specifies: Refurbished electronics — the auction-lot, best-instrumented version
markets.scale: ~1,000 mobile auctions closing per week on B-Stock; 5M+ phones/yr; Mobile Carrier ~500 lots/wk (grades AA+–RR); hundreds of model × storage × carrier SKUs.
markets.data: B-Stock closed-auction history (login); Swappa sold prices; Aikon grade benchmarks (−12% to −90% vs A); CTIA functional 0–9 × cosmetic A–D grading.
markets.menu: Lot (storefront × grade × model mix × qty × IMEI list) × bid — mutually exclusive lots per closing day
markets.risk: Functional yield, locks, battery health only after receipt; weekly price decay; reseller-cert/R2 gate.
markets.experiment: Refurbisher's 12 months of B-Stock bids (won and lost) + yield/resale ledger; score lots; measure predicted vs realised recovery by grade.
markets.sales_tape: Win → receive → test/grade → activation-lock & yield → refurb → resale over 2–6 weeks → returns

markets.name: Fresh produce terminal-market wholesale (Hunts Point & regional terminals)
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Agricultural surplus and off-grade lots; Short-dated food closeouts (both cover off-spec — this is primary spot wholesale)
markets.scale: Hunts Point: ~47 merchants, $2–2.3B/yr, ~23,000 restaurant customers, ~9% of US produce; ~13 USDA-reported terminal markets; daily lot counts not published.
markets.data: USDA AMS Market News terminal & shipping-point reports (daily, by commodity/origin/size) + MyMarketNews API (free key, bulk download) — best public feed in this list.
markets.menu: Merchant offer (commodity × origin × size/grade × pack) × cases × day
markets.risk: Declined offers must be captured by the agent (no electronic book); shrink attribution per lot; PACA prompt-pay trust; hours-scale cadence stresses fit latency.
markets.experiment: Instrument one wholesaler's daily buys + passed offers for 30 days against USDA terminal prices; replay shrink-adjusted margin; test abstention on volatile commodities.
markets.sales_tape: Purchase → cold storage → restaurant/retail sale (hours–days) → rejections/credits → shrink write-off

markets.name: Consignment intake decisions (luxury & local resale shops)
markets.overlap: New — refusal-first market (accept/decline per item offered)
markets.scale: TRR FY2025: consignment revenue $535.9M of $693M; 1.056M active buyers; take rate 36.5% (Q4'25).
markets.data: Platform sold listings; Rebag Clair; no accept/decline datasets published — the shop's own intake log is the asset.
markets.menu: Offered item (category × brand × condition × asking/quote × consignor) × accept / buyout / decline × price
markets.risk: Shelf capacity is the binding constraint; regrade after receipt; low consumption.
markets.experiment: Consignment shop: 24 months of intake decisions incl. declines + sales; shadow-score intake; measure inventory-turn gain.
markets.sales_tape: Intake → authentication/regrade → listing → sale → returns → consignor payout (day 15–21) → unsold return after ~90 days

markets.name: Used networking & data-centre gear (ITAD lots)
markets.overlap: Specifies: Refurbished electronics / 'Surplus laptops and IT gear' (landing page)
markets.scale: ITAD market $28.3B (2025) → $31.9B (2026); Liquidity Services 500+ categories; servers hold value 3–5 yrs from release.
markets.data: Closed-auction prices on Liquidity Services marketplaces; dealer quotes; no public used-Cisco/Dell index.
markets.menu: Lot (equipment class × model × qty × drive status × rails/licences) × bid
markets.risk: Component yields, BMC/BIOS locks, missing transceivers; data-sanitisation obligations.
markets.experiment: ITAD reseller's 12 months of lot bids (won/lost) + yield + resale; score lots by class/age.
markets.sales_tape: Win → sanitisation (NIST 800-88) → component test → resale (weeks) → yield write-offs

markets.name: Printing paper stocklots & side-runs (Go2Paper, PaperIndex)
markets.overlap: New — distinct from recovered-material bales (this is unused stock)
markets.scale: No listing/volume counts published; lot structure (basis weight × brightness × width × core) unverified on the help pages.
markets.data: No public benchmark; Fastmarkets RISI (paid) as reference; price discovery by RFP.
markets.menu: Lot (grade × basis weight × brightness × width × core × location) × tons × price → matched to a printer's job
markets.risk: Spec matching is the business; freight on jumbo rolls; counterparty and quality risk off-platform; slow RFQ cycles on PaperIndex.
markets.experiment: Paper merchant's 12 months of stocklot offers (taken/passed) with conversion cost and sale price.
markets.sales_tape: Buy → jumbo-roll freight → slit/convert → sale to printer → off-spec claims

markets.name: Private-label product launches (Alibaba → Amazon/marketplace) — venture-class bets
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Amazon wholesale / OA — launch selection (no supplier approval) is a different decision
markets.scale: Unbounded niche menu (Helium 10 / Jungle Scout); Jungle Scout 2025 survey: 40% cite rising costs, 30% fewer sourcing from China; de minimis ended May/Aug 2025.
markets.data: Helium 10 / Jungle Scout demand estimates; Keepa; Brand Analytics (sellers only); no public per-launch outcome dataset — '90% fail' claims unsourced.
markets.menu: Launch (niche × supplier quote × MOQ × unit cost × freight × tariff × ad budget) × order qty — each row is a small startup
markets.risk: Data floor: $4–12k per observed launch → ≥100 observed launches ≈ $0.5–1M of history for one operator; 3–6 month cycles; tariff drift; platform suspension risk.
markets.experiment: Pool anonymised launch ledgers from several aggregators/agencies (enterprise); test if P34 abstains on launches that later died; membership version = only for operators with 100+ past launches.
markets.sales_tape: PO → inspection → freight → FBA → sales/PPC → reviews → returns → reorder or liquidation

markets.name: Electronic fish auctions (Pefa clock network; Portland Fish Exchange)
markets.overlap: New
markets.scale: Dutch first sale 2025: 26,682 t / €145M across 12 auctions (7 on Pefa); dozens of species × size × grade per port; lots/day not published.
markets.data: Pefa Data (paid); EUMOFA first-sale prices (free weekly/monthly); PFEX daily/weekly price reports; live clock.
markets.menu: Lot (species × size × grade × port × vessel) × boxes × clock price
markets.risk: Per-auction bank guarantees; lot counts unverified; yield/shrink only after processing; same-day cadence.
markets.experiment: Subscribe to one Pefa clock; record every lot and pass for 6 weeks; shadow-score against a fishmonger's realised resale; measure abstention value on gluts.
markets.sales_tape: Clock buy → same-day cold-chain → processor/retail sale → yield loss/shrink → claims

markets.name: Excess & obsolete electronic components brokerage (independent distribution)
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Spare-parts stocking; Industrial surplus equipment — MPN brokerage is distinct
markets.scale: 1B+ MPNs; 621,909 components EOL'd in 2025 (52% without PCN); 2026 shortage: DRAM contract +90–95% QoQ Q1 2026, FPGA lead times 40 wks, MCU up to 55 wks.
markets.data: Nexar / Sourcengine APIs (price, stock); Z2Data / SiliconExpert lifecycle (paid); ERAI reports; TrendForce; Baird lead-time monitor.
markets.menu: Line (MPN × date code × qty × source × price × test level) × buy/pass against RFQ demand
markets.risk: Counterfeit/nonconforming risk (ERAI 748 reports 2025; 24% pass electrical-only tests); shortage cycles are multi-quarter regimes; spreads unpublished.
markets.experiment: Broker's 24 months of RFQs, quotes, buys and sales; join test results; score buy/pass per line under shortage/normal regimes with lifecycle features.
markets.sales_tape: Buy → AS6081 test (days) → sale to OEM/EMS → returns/nonconformance → write-off of unsold reels

markets.name: Used lab & scientific equipment (LabX, BioSurplus, EquipNet, Heritage Global)
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Industrial surplus equipment
markets.scale: Listing counts not published; HGP ~20+ biotech auctions Jan–Jul 2026; university surplus via Public Surplus/GovDeals.
markets.data: No public sold-price index; Bidspotter results after login; LabX asking prices.
markets.menu: Lot (instrument × model × calibration/service status × removal window) × bid
markets.risk: Scale unverified; software licences and calibration unknown until powered; export controls on some analytical gear.
markets.experiment: Lab-equipment dealer's auction bids (won/lost) + test outcomes + resale for 12 months; score by instrument class.
markets.sales_tape: Win → rigging/decon → test → resale (weeks) → OEM licence transfer issues

markets.name: Insurance-salvage merchandise lots (Salvex, Fr8Auctions, insurer programs)
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Liquidation and B-stock pallets; Returned-goods resale — insurer supply is distinct
markets.scale: Salvex ~5k live lots (heavily industrial/aviation); Liquidity Services FY2025 GMV $1.57B, 6.0M registered buyers; Fr8 weekly.
markets.data: Per-listing bid counts on Salvex; closed prices for registered Liquidity Services users; no index.
markets.menu: Lot (category × damage type × manifest completeness × location × branding restriction) × bid
markets.risk: Damage extent hidden; control-of-damaged-goods clauses (brands destroy instead of salvage); Fr8 gate.
markets.experiment: Salvage buyer's 12 months of bids (won/lost, bid counts) + recovery ledger; score lots by damage type.
markets.sales_tape: Win → freight → inspection/sort → resale by channel → destruction of de-labelled goods

markets.name: Mill-end textiles & flexible-packaging film remnants (B2B)
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Deadstock and branded apparel lots; Industrial by-products — remnant rolls into small jobs is new
markets.scale: No published volumes; jobber deadstock $5–15/yd at 50–70% below mill price (Style3D, marketing source).
markets.data: No index or API; quote-driven.
markets.menu: Roll (spec × width × length × location × age) × qty × price → matched to a small job
markets.risk: Thin comps; freight can exceed remnant value; actual yardage, flaws and (for film) treatment decay hidden until receipt; film-remnant side unverified.
markets.experiment: Jobber's 12 months of lots offered/taken and sell-through by spec; test spec-match features vs realised margin.
markets.sales_tape: Buy → LTL → cut/convert or resell → yardage shortfall, defects, dye-lot disputes

markets.name: Nursery stock & live-plant wholesale (landscape trade)
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Rare plants and seeds (collectibles) — this is trade wholesale
markets.scale: USDA 2019 census: $13.8B, 20,655 operations; nursery stock $4.55B; PlantANT claims 613,182 listings / 36,871 varieties; CA+FL+OR = 66% of sales.
markets.data: Grower availability lists (weekly PDF/Excel); LandscapeHub member pricing; ANSI Z60.1 grading; no public price index.
markets.menu: Plant (species × cultivar × size × container × grower) × quantity × landed price
markets.risk: Seasonality and weather; mortality attribution; phytosanitary quarantines; no central price archive.
markets.experiment: Aggregate 20 growers' availability lists weekly for a season; join a landscaper's job pipeline and yard shrink; score buy-vs-pass per line.
markets.sales_tape: Purchase → freight → hold in yard → job installation or retail sale → mortality/shrink write-off

markets.name: Biomass wood-chip / pellet spot (BALTPOOL-class auctions)
markets.overlap: New
markets.scale: 2020–21 season: 4M MWh traded, 453 registered participants (117 international) — dated; 2025 volumes unverified. Avg supply prices then LT €10.89/MWh, LV €12.15, EE €12.90.
markets.data: BALTPOOL public market data and monthly statistics; Argus Biomass Markets (paid); US pellet/chip indexes paid (ResourceWise, FutureMetrics).
markets.menu: Lot (quality class × origin × delivery week × distance) × MWh × €/MWh bid
markets.risk: Moisture and haul dominate value; EU sustainability certification (RED III/SBP); auction results public incl. unmatched bids — good declined-option record.
markets.experiment: Replay BALTPOOL auction history for a supplier: bids won/lost vs delivered-energy settlement; test abstention on long-haul lots.
markets.sales_tape: Award → delivery → moisture/ash measurement → settlement on delivered energy → penalties

markets.name: Vehicle-transport load boards (Central Dispatch class)
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Truckload boards; Backhaul matching (this is per-vehicle, multi-car routing)
markets.scale: Central Dispatch: 10,000,000+ vehicles posted/yr (~27k/day), 20,000+ carriers; cancellations +24.8% H1-26, 4.64% of orders cancelled for inadequate rate.
markets.data: In-app daily market price tool; CCJ rate surveys ($2.04/mi short haul ≈ $623/vehicle; $0.55/mi cross-country ≈ $1,534); no open API.
markets.menu: Load (vehicle × origin/destination × pickup window × open/enclosed × rate) × accept/decline given truck position and open slots
markets.risk: Rolling menu with interference (paper: rapidly expiring menus); declined loads must be logged by the dispatcher agent; damage-claim rates not published.
markets.experiment: Carrier with 3–9 car trailers: 6 months of board snapshots + accepted/declined loads + realised margin per trip; score load sets under routing constraints.
markets.sales_tape: Accept → pickup → delivery (BOL inspection) → damage claims → payment (net terms/quick-pay)

markets.name: Inland barge spot capacity (shipper-side quoting)
markets.overlap: New — distinct from Ocean freight capacity and Container repositioning
markets.scale: Rates quoted as % of the 1976 benchmark tariff × $/ton (St. Louis $3.99, Twin Cities $6.19, Cairo–Memphis $3.14); USDA GTR publishes weekly grain-barge tons and rates.
markets.data: USDA AMS Grain Transportation Report (weekly); agtransport.usda.gov Barge Dashboard + 3-month forward rate datasets (Socrata downloads); OpenTug rate guide.
markets.menu: Quote (lane × commodity × tons × sailing week × draft/tow constraints) × accept / decline
markets.risk: Draft restrictions, lock outages and low-water spikes (Oct 2022) are regime shocks; fleeting/demurrage hidden; declined quotes must be self-logged.
markets.experiment: Grain shipper/broker's 12 months of quotes accepted/declined vs USDA weekly rates and realised transit cost.
markets.sales_tape: Booking → loading → transit (locks, river stage) → delivery → demurrage/cleaning → payment

markets.name: TikTok Shop / dropship product tests — venture-class, days cadence
markets.overlap: New (Marketplace sponsored listings is the ad side; this is product-test selection)
markets.scale: US: ~475k–800k shops (sources conflict), ~216k with sales; US GMV 2025 ~$15B (Canopy); global $64–66B; ~2,000 US shops >$1M.
markets.data: Seller Center analytics (own); Kalodata / FastMoss cross-shop estimates; no public return/CAC archive.
markets.menu: Product test (SKU × supplier × price × creative × affiliate commission × ad budget) × launch/skip — thousands of candidate products per week
markets.risk: Platform-rule volatility (referral fee 6%→8% Aug 2026; gated categories); attribution of affiliate/ad demand; constraints change under you (gate 'Constraints' = Partial).
markets.experiment: Operator with 300+ past product tests: replay launch/skip decisions with ad spend and return tape; test 7-day kill/scale policy vs P34 abstention; keep fees as dated features.
markets.sales_tape: Launch → ad/affiliate spend → orders → delivery → returns/refunds → payout; kill or scale within days

markets.name: Standing timber & log sales (state/federal auctions, private stumpage, log yards)
markets.overlap: New
markets.scale: USFS FY2025 sold 2.94 BBF (goal 4 BBF by FY28); WA DNR monthly auctions with results published since 1969; sample GNA sales 2,442–11,547 MBF, 2 of 4 with no bids.
markets.data: WA DNR / ODF full bid archives incl. no-bid sales; USFS cut-and-sold reports; TimberMart-South (quarterly, subscription); state extension price reports.
markets.menu: Sale (tract × species mix × cruised volume × haul distance × contract term) × bid $/MBF or $/ton
markets.risk: Feedback arrives over months–years (paper boundary: too slow vs regime); $1M+ tickets on public sales; operator fit (crews, mills) dominates; cruise vs scale error is the market.
markets.experiment: Backtest 10 years of DNR/ODF results incl. no-bid sales against delivered-log price series; test whether P34 abstains on single-bidder tracts that later lost money.
markets.sales_tape: Award → logging → scaling at mill → delivered-log payments over months → defect/grade recovery variance

markets.name: Contingency recruiting job-order selection (split-fee networks)
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Freelance-platform work arbitrage; Lead purchasing; B2B outbound prospecting
markets.scale: Open job orders per network unpublished; fees 15–25% of first-year base; time-to-fill ~36 days; Paraform avg placed comp $260k.
markets.data: No public archive; BountyJobs exposes employer responsiveness/payment metrics; the agency's own ATS holds worked vs passed reqs.
markets.menu: Job order (role × employer × fee % × exclusivity × location × responsiveness) × work / pass × sourcing hours
markets.risk: Fall-off and non-payment 60–90+ days later; capacity (recruiter hours) is the constraint; no logistics.
markets.experiment: Agency's 3 years of ATS job orders (worked/passed) + placements/fall-offs; shadow-score req selection.
markets.sales_tape: Submit → interview → placement → 60–90 day guarantee → fall-off / non-payment → fee received

markets.name: Hay, forage & feed lots
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Small livestock and equipment auctions
markets.scale: USDA AMS state reports (CA 9/25/2026: 25,550 t + 44,544 bales confirmed); HayWire index 83 quotes/19 markets weekly; national $166/t (wk of 21 Sep 2026).
markets.data: USDA AMS Market News (free; MyMarketNews API); HayWire index; extension surveys. Prices: Alfalfa Premium $300–310/t, Fair $109–165/t; TX $345 vs MN $111.
markets.menu: Lot (type × quality grade × bale format × location × test status) × tons × delivered price
markets.risk: Few asset types (breadth low); freight 30–50% of delivered price dominates; quality tests 'honor system'; regional spreads are the edge.
markets.experiment: Take 12 months of AMS + auction data; join a hay dealer's buys, freight and sales; test whether regional spread minus freight predicts realised margin and when to pass.
markets.sales_tape: Buy → truck → store → resale or feed-out over weeks → moisture/mold rejection

markets.name: Recycled pallet, IBC tote & drum trading
markets.overlap: New
markets.scale: 48forty: 240+ facilities, 850+ partners; Q1-2026 report: 396 verified supplier listings in 50 states; core buy avg $2.75 (range $1.60–12.84), Grade A sell avg $9.04, regional spread 85%.
markets.data: Repackify pricing guides; usedpalletrecycling quarterly report; Pallet Enterprise surveys (paywalled). IBC avg $61 (range $11–144).

markets.risk: Few SKUs (breadth low); freight decides everything; grade drift at the dock; hazmat residue on totes.
markets.experiment: One recycler's 12 months of core buys, sort yields, repair labour and sales by lane; score buy/pass per source and lane; test regional spread capture.
markets.sales_tape: Buy cores → sort/repair → truckload sale → dock re-grade / rejection

markets.name: Retired toy lines & mass collectibles (Funko, Hot Wheels STH, Pop Mart/Labubu, Jellycat)

markets.risk: Fad-driven regimes (Labubu 2026 cooling); counterfeits (11,000+ seized Seattle 2025); low consumption → capital competition.

markets.name: Luxury handbag & accessories resale (Fashionphile, Rebag, TRR, eBay AG)

markets.name: Specialty green-coffee spot lots (importer spot lists, Cup of Excellence)

markets.name: Unclaimed freight, abandoned cargo & customs (General Order) auctions
markets.overlap: Adjacent: Liquidation and B-stock pallets; Storage unit auctions (different supply)
markets.scale: GO goods saleable 6 months after import (19 CFR 127.4); auction frequency/lot counts unpublished; Fr8 weekly.
